protocol.claim_status: prospective hidden-state pilot; route confirmation required
protocol.hypothesis: A globally nonlinear LLM has a locally identifiable, context-conditioned response map at the L21 answer-prefix causal interface. Generic target-blind probes can identify that map well enough to synthesize an unseen operation-state transition.

minimum_score.preamble: Compare the numerical scores and return the lowest-scoring label.
minimum_score.rule: The selected label is the one with the smallest score.
minimum_score.story: {state} scored one point. {d1} scored five points. {d2} scored nine points.
minimum_score.question: Which label had the lowest score?

set_intersection.preamble: Find the unique label that occurs in both stated groups.
set_intersection.rule: Return the sole member of the set intersection.
set_intersection.story: GROUP_ONE contains {state} and {d1}. GROUP_TWO contains {state} and {d2}.
set_intersection.question: Which label appears in both groups?

training_only_construction.basis: rank-4 SVD of four family mean L21 controllers
training_only_construction.shared_target: normalized mean of normalized family processed L27 BELIEF-to-SEARCH targets, restored to median target norm

pre_target_controls: other held-out family response map, norm matched
same held-out family opposite-origin response map, norm matched
post_freeze_oracles: training-basis projection of exact L21 target
local inverse toward exact held-out L27 target
protocol.stopping_rule: No prompt, family, row, layer, rank, probe scale, inverse regularization, norm cap, control or threshold changes follow the output.
